AI Voice Changer lets you swap your voice in real time and generate original songs from any text. Whether you're making a rap track for fun, pranking your friends with a robot voice, or turning a poem into a full beat — it all happens right on your phone.

What you can do:

Change your voice live — deepen it, pitch it up, go robotic or cinematic. 
Generate full songs from text — type lyrics, get music. 
No music experience required. Just hit record.
Start free — unlock unlimited voices and song generation with a weekly subscription.
